agentSummary: Connects NeoStack to Epic's in-editor MCP server (UE 5.8 experimental ModelContextProtocol plugin): opt-in publication of NeoStack tools and skills into Epic's server, allow-listed use of Epic MCP tools and MCP Tool Library assets, and a port coexistence report.
enablesAgentTo: Report whether Epic's MCP server is running, on which port, and whether it collides with NeoStack's
Discover Epic's MCP tools (list_toolsets, describe_toolset, call_tool) and Blueprint MCP Tool Library functions with their JSON schemas
Call allow-listed Epic MCP tools with NeoStack's single-flight and timeout policy
Read Epic MCP resources, including NeoStack skills served as neostack://skills/<name>
Publish NeoStack's execute_script, help, skills, integrations and status into Epic's server for the session (opt-in)
whenToEnable: Your project enables Epic's experimental ModelContextProtocol plugin (UE 5.8) and you want Epic's MCP clients or assistant to reach NeoStack, or NeoStack agents to reach Epic's MCP tools.
